lineage.detail: USGS FDSN event service, 2.5+ within 300 km
event id present and unique, coordinates finite and in range, magnitude finite, origin time parseable
projected to EPSG:32645 to measure distance from the epicentre; hours from main shock derived

validation.expectedMainShock: M7.8 at 2015-04-25T06:11:25.950Z per the USGS event page

limitations: Catalogue completeness falls off below about M4 in the days right after the main shock, when small events are masked by the coda of larger ones. Counts of small aftershocks are therefore a lower bound.
Depths for shallow continental events carry uncertainties of several kilometres and some are fixed by the analyst rather than solved.
Events outside Nepal are retained deliberately: an aftershock sequence does not stop at a border, and clipping would distort its spatial distribution.
